mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_case_action ac WHERE ac.target_id=#{orderId} AND ac.target_type='rental_order' AND ac.action_type='resolve_order_issue' AND ac.operator_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND ac.action_status='succeeded' AND ac.request_payload_json->>'$.fulfillment_decision'='terminate')
mapper.sql: SELECT o.id, NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_return_check rc WHERE rc.rental_order_id=o.id AND rc.claim_created=1) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_claim cl WHERE cl.rental_order_id=o.id AND cl.claim_status NOT IN ('draft','withdrawn','rejected'))) ready, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_issue_report i WHERE i.rental_order_id=o.id AND i.fulfillment_effect='paused' AND i.issue_status NOT IN ('resolved','closed')) source_paused, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_receipt_check rc WHERE rc.rental_order_id=o.id AND (rc.check_status='problem_reported' OR rc.remaining_check_ms IS NOT NULL)) timer_paused, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_claim cl WHERE cl.rental_order_id=o.id AND cl.claim_status NOT IN ('draft','withdrawn','rejected','closed')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_case ac WHERE ac.rental_order_id=o.id AND ac.case_status NOT IN ('closed','cancelled')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_return_check rc WHERE rc.rental_order_id=o.id AND rc.remaining_close_ms IS NOT NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_intervention_record pi WHERE pi.rental_order_id=o.id AND pi.intervention_status IN ('open','processing'))) claim_active, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM admin_case_action a WHERE a.target_id=o.id AND a.parent_action_id IS NULL AND a.action_type='resolve_order_issue' AND a.operator_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND a.action_status IN ('executing','failed','succeeded') AND a.request_payload_json->>'$.fulfillment_decision'='terminate') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_issue_report i WHERE i.rental_order_id=o.id AND i.resolution_type='cancel_refund' AND i.issue_status NOT IN ('resolved','closed'))) termination_active FROM rental_order o
mapper.select: SELECT f.ready,(f.source_paused OR f.timer_paused) paused,f.claim_active,f.termination_active FROM ( WHERE o.id=#{orderId}) f
SELECT f.id,f.ready,(f.source_paused OR f.timer_paused) paused,f.claim_active,f.termination_active FROM ( WHERE o.id IN #{id}) f

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ( WHERE o.id=#{orderId}) f WHERE f.ready AND f.timer_paused AND NOT f.source_paused AND NOT f.claim_active AND NOT f.termination_active AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_issue_report i WHERE i.rental_order_id=f.id AND i.issue_scene='receipt' AND ((i.fulfillment_effect='paused' AND i.issue_status IN ('resolved','closed') AND i.resolved_at IS NOT NULL) OR i.resolution_type='continue_fulfillment')))
SELECT f.id FROM ( AND o.buyer_user_id=#{buyerId} AND o.factory_id=#{factoryId}) f WHERE NOT f.ready OR f.source_paused OR f.timer_paused OR f.claim_active OR f.termination_active
